speak.title: Role-play: glasses in the cafe
speak.setup: Work in pairs. Read your card, then have the conversation. Swap roles and do it again.

a.text: A customer is wearing smart glasses with a camera. Two other customers have complained. Politely ask what the glasses do. Decide if the customer can keep them on, and say why.

b.text: You wear smart glasses to read the menu and signs because your eyesight is poor. You aren't recording anyone. Explain this calmly and suggest a way to make people feel comfortable.

phrases: Excuse me, could I ask about your glasses?
I'm not recording anyone, I promise.
Some customers aren't comfortable with cameras.
I'd be happy to show you how they work.
That's fair, I'll make sure the light is visible.
speak.after: Afterwards, tell the class: did the manager and the customer agree, and was the solution fair to everyone?
